Exchange/platform: Gate
Headline: SPCX Orbital Data Center Trading Challenge
Start: 2026-11-26T10:00:00Z · End: 2026-12-03T10:00:00Z
Smallest threshold (parsed): 100 USD (trade)
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
AI Computing — Is Space Next? On November 25, the US FCC granted partial communications authorization for SpaceX's "Starmind" orbital data center system, with a planned scale cap of 1 million satellites. This marks progress for the plan — it does not mean the satellites have been deployed or that space computing is in operation; launch scale, thermal management, cost and commercialization progress remain to be seen. During the SPCX Space Computing Trading Challenge, register and trade the designated SPCX stock products on the event page to earn draw chances. The prize pool consists of 9 prizes: 4 × 20 USDT SPCX stock trial bonus, 4 × SPCX tokens, and 1 × 5 USDT fee cashback voucher. Each valid draw wins one prize; limited quantity, until fully drawn.
Join Now
## Event Period: November 26, 2026, 10:00 – December 3, 2026, 10:00 (UTC)
## Lucky Draw: Complete Tasks, Win Stock Tokens and Fee Rebates
During the campaign, users earn draw entries by completing the following tasks:
Task Type | Completion Criteria | Draw Entries
First Transfer | Complete your first-ever transfer into your stock account during the campaign, with the first transfer ≥ $100 | 1 (max 1)
First Trade | Complete your first-ever stock trade during the campaign, with the first trade volume ≥ $100 | 1 (max 1)
Daily Check-in | Daily cumulative stock trading volume ≥ 1,000 | 1 (max 1 per day)
All-Users Trading | Cumulative stock trading volume reaches 500 / 10,000 / 50,000 / 100,000 | 1 / 3 / 6 / 10
- The prize pool is updated daily at 00:00 (UTC) ; once that day's prizes are drawn, unused draw entries roll over to the next prize-pool refresh. If all prizes are drawn on the final day, the campaign ends automatically.
## Important Notes
- Users must click "Join Now" on the event page to complete registration and must complete identity verification before registering. Eligible regions are subject to the event page.
- Only valid executions of the designated SPCX products completed on the Gate Stocks page after registration and within the event period are counted. Unfilled orders, cancelled orders, off-exchange transactions, asset transfers and trades in non-designated instruments are not counted.
- Cumulative valid trading volume is the sum of buy and sell executed amounts of the designated products, converted to USDT equivalent at the time of execution according to the platform's calculation basis, subject to Gate's system records.
- The first transfer and the first trade are each limited to one count. Daily check-ins are counted by UTC+8 calendar days. For the cumulative trading volume task, draw chances are granted at the highest tier reached; lower-tier chances are not combined.
- Each valid draw awards one prize from the pool. For stock trial bonuses, the applicable products, minimum tradable share quantity, validity period and principal and profit handling are subject to the trial bonus product rules and voucher terms; for cashback vouchers, the scope of use and validity period are subject to the voucher terms.
- The prize pool consists of 9 prizes in total: 4 × 20 USDT SPCX stock trial bonus, 4 × SPCX token, and 1 × 5 USDT fee cashback voucher. Prize quantities and distribution arrangements are subject to the event page.
- Event fairness and risk-control verification: Gate will verify accounts, trades and fund flows during the event. Violations include repeated participation with multiple accounts, impersonation or submission of false verification materials, self-trading or matched orders, circulating on-chain funds, organizing schemes to extract rewards, repeated fund transfers, and other acts that undermine event fairness. Upon verification, Gate reserves the right to revoke the relevant users' reward eligibility.
- Trading in stocks and related products involves market volatility, liquidity, exchange rate and policy risks. This event does not constitute investment advice or a promise of returns. Please participate prudently according to your own risk tolerance.
- Reward distribution and event adjustments are subject to official event page announcements.
